thanks.r: For allowing me to do what I want to.
For loving and believing in me unconditionally
For allowing me to be who I am and always supporting me in any way y'all can.
For being there with tasty food and listening to everything I have to say
For hanging out with me even after so many fights as kids
For being a partner in crime and always having discussions even after having a different perspective
For being down to hang out whenever asked to no matter what
For helping and guiding me whenever I have needed it
For introducing me to new content and always hitting the nail with it
For always being ready to gossip about anything
For having fun with me anytime and every time
For allowing me to be a collaborator on an incredible project amongst other things
For always being there to talk about nerdy shit and allowing me to enjoy it tenfold
For being someone I can always end up having fun with, regardless of however life is going
For being someone who has been always there to talk about how life is treating us
For having your door always open for me even when y'all might not be there yourself at home
For enduring and indulging in various shenanigans through college and beyond
For being my friends and making school worth looking forward to every week
For being one of the first people to believe in me as a kid and making me feel good about being myself
For tolerating me when I did not deserve the kindness and giving me more than ample chances to be a better version of myself without asking for anything in return
For making me fall in love with a subject I almost came to despise
For allowing me to appreciate myself through my art

about.body: A 24-year-old creative with a background in fine arts and a keen interest in audio-visual storytelling, music, and the many ways people experience media. An avid gamer, comic and manga reader, and film enthusiast, I enjoy exploring stories across different formats and mediums. There's always more to watch, read, listen to, learn, and create than time allows, but I'm constantly looking for ways to expand my creative horizons and turn that curiosity into meaningful work.
